The structure of Ca4Ho4Sb4O24 (reduced formula CaHoSbO6) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 36 atoms in the unit cell distributed over 7 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Ca in octahedral coordination by six O atoms, Ho in octahedral coordination by six O atoms, and Sb in tetrahedral coordination by four O atoms. The O centers have three geometric neighbors (Ca, Ho, or Sb), and the connectivity forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 36 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Ca octahedra and Sb tetrahedra, and edge-sharing between Ca and Ho octahedra.
